question: How are the many womb-cavities within maya illustrated by analogy?
premises: Many inner rooms can be enclosed within one hall.
The womb-cavities exist within one head-hall of maya.
The verse compares the two structures directly.
inference: The many womb-cavities of maya are arranged like many enclosed rooms within a single hall.
uncertainties: The term 'head-hall of maya' is metaphorical and not further explained here.
plain_english: Just as many enclosed inner rooms can exist within one hall, so many womb-cavities exist within the single head-hall of maya.
